subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source opt-out for the built-in personal `.agents/skills` root, and if so should it be a general disabled-source list or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The source-level issue is real, but adding a new config/default surface changes a built-in skill discovery contract and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs.

options.title: Add a typed source opt-out
options.body: Expose a backward-compatible `skills.load` setting that skips named built-in sources before loader discovery and watcher registration, with default behavior unchanged.

options.title: Document existing allowlists only
options.body: Decline a source-level opt-out and document `agents.defaults.skills` / `agents.list[].skills` as the supported prompt-bloat mitigation while preserving current scanning.

options.title: Defer to skill selection redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open as part of a broader on-demand skill-loading design rather than adding a short-term config knob now.

recommendation.title: Add a typed source opt-out
recommendation.body: Expose a backward-compatible `skills.load` setting that skips named built-in sources before loader discovery and watcher registration, with default behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and watcher history place this account closest to the current skills loader/watcher/config surface where the product decision would land.
